movements.name: Wall Push-Up
cues: Hands on the wall at shoulder height
One straight line from head to heels
Lower slowly, then press the wall away
inSetCues: Elbows point back, not out to the sides
If your hips lead, squeeze your glutes

movements.name: Wide Wall Push-Up
cues: Hands on the wall, wider than your shoulders
Keep your body in one line
Chest toward the wall, then press away
inSetCues: Shoulders down, away from your ears
Lead with your chest, not your chin

movements.name: Wall Push-Up Hold
cues: Lower halfway to the wall and hold
Body straight, elbows soft
Breathe steadily
inSetCues: If your elbows creep up, tuck them back
Hips stay in line, keep breathing

movements.name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Chair against a wall, hands on the seat
One straight line from head to heels
Lower slowly, press back up
inSetCues: If your hips sag, squeeze your glutes
Eyes on the seat, neck long

movements.name: Wide Incline Push-Up
cues: Chair against a wall, hands wide on the seat
Brace your middle
Chest to the chair, then press away
inSetCues: If your shoulders rise, press them down
Hips stay level with your shoulders

movements.name: Incline Push-Up Hold
cues: Chair against a wall, hands on the seat
Lower halfway and hold there
Squeeze your middle and keep breathing
inSetCues: If you drift up, lower back to halfway
Brace your middle, keep breathing

movements.name: Kneeling Push-Up
cues: Knees down, hands under your shoulders
One line from knees to head
Lower with control, press up strong
inSetCues: If your hips pike, push them forward
Elbows back, close to your ribs

movements.name: Wide Kneeling Push-Up
cues: Knees down, hands set wide
Hips in line with your back
Slow on the way down, strong on the way up
inSetCues: If your lower back dips, squeeze your glutes
Shoulders down as you press up

movements.name: Incline Pike Push-Up
cues: Chair against a wall, hands on the seat
Walk feet back and lift your hips high
Bend your elbows, head toward the chair
Press back until your hips are high
inSetCues: Hips stay high, do not flatten out
Head down toward the seat, not forward

movements.name: Full Push-Up
cues: Hands under shoulders, legs long
One straight line from head to heels
Lower slowly, chest near the floor
Press the floor away
inSetCues: If your hips sag, finish on your knees
Hips and chest rise together

movements.name: Pike Push-Up
cues: Hips high, hands and feet on the floor
Bend your elbows, head toward the floor
Press back up until your hips are high
inSetCues: Hips high, head goes down, not forward
If it strains, bend your elbows less

movements.name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Chair against a wall, feet on the seat
Hands under your shoulders
Lower slowly, press up strong
inSetCues: If your hips pike, lower them in line
Eyes on the floor, neck long

movements.name: Archer Push-Up
cues: Hands set wide on the floor
Lower toward one hand, other arm long
Press back to the middle
Switch sides each rep
inSetCues: Hips square, do not twist
If you twist, lower less far

movements.name: Forearm Wall Push
cues: Forearms flat on the wall, elbows at shoulder height
Walk your feet back so you lean into the wall
Let your chest sink toward the wall
Drive your forearms into the wall and push away
inSetCues: Push through your forearms, not your hands
Hips stay in line with your heels

movements.name: Fist Wall Push-Up
cues: Fists on the wall at shoulder height, thumbs on the outside
Wrists straight, one line from head to heels
Lower slowly, then press the wall away
inSetCues: If your wrists bend, straighten and lock them
Elbows back, not out to the sides

movements.name: Chair Grip Push-Up
cues: Chair against a wall, grip the sides of the seat
Thumbs up, wrists straight
One straight line from head to heels
Lower your chest to the chair, then press away
inSetCues: Wrists stay straight as you lower
Hips level, do not let them dip

movements.name: Fist Kneeling Push-Up
cues: Knees down, fists under your shoulders
Wrists straight and locked, thumbs on the outside
Something soft under your knuckles helps
Lower with control, press up strong
inSetCues: If your fists roll, reset them upright
Hips forward, in line with your back

movements.name: Fist Push-Up
cues: Fold a towel under your knuckles
Fists under your shoulders, thumbs on the outside
Wrists straight and locked, one line from head to heels
Lower slowly, then press the floor away
inSetCues: If your wrists bend, lower less far
Hips stay in one line, squeeze your glutes

movements.name: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
cues: Stand tall, arms by your sides
Draw your shoulder blades together
Hold a moment, then release
inSetCues: Squeeze back and down, not up
Ribs down, do not arch your back

movements.name: Wall Slide
cues: Stand with your back against the wall
Arms bent, backs of your hands on the wall
Slide your arms up, then pull them down
inSetCues: If your back arches, slide less high
Backs of your hands stay on the wall

movements.name: Prone W Raise
cues: Lie face down, arms bent in a W shape
Lift your hands and elbows off the floor
Squeeze between your shoulder blades
Lower slowly
inSetCues: Forehead stays down, neck long
Lift with your shoulder blades, not your neck

movements.name: Doorframe Lean Row
cues: Hold the doorframe with both hands, feet close
Lean back until your arms are long
Pull your chest to the frame, then lower
inSetCues: Hips forward, body in one line
Shoulders down as you pull

movements.name: Prone Y Raise
cues: Lie face down, arms long in a Y shape
Thumbs up, lift both arms off the floor
Lower with control
inSetCues: Arms long, thumbs up the whole time
If your lower back works, lift less high

movements.name: Doorframe Row
cues: Grip the frame, walk your feet forward
Lean back with arms straight
Pull your chest to your hands
Lower back out with control
inSetCues: Pull your elbows back, not out wide
If your hips fold, tuck them forward

movements.name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
cues: Lie face down, arms in a Y shape
Lift, then move to a T, then a W
Keep your arms off the floor the whole time
Lower and start again
inSetCues: Arms stay off the floor between shapes
Forehead down, move slow and steady

movements.name: Deep Doorframe Row
cues: Feet far forward, body at a strong lean
Dry your hands, grip firm
Pull your chest to the frame, elbows back
Lower slowly
inSetCues: If your grip slips, walk your feet back
Hips forward, squeeze your glutes

movements.name: Single-Arm Doorframe Row
cues: One hand on the frame, feet forward
Keep your hips square
Pull your chest to your hand
Slow on the way back
inSetCues: If your hips open, turn them back square
Lead with your working elbow, not your hand

movements.name: Single-Arm Doorframe Row with Pause
cues: Feet further forward this time
Pull in and pause at the top
Lower slowly, hips square
inSetCues: Hold the top still, no bounce
Working shoulder down, hips square

movements.name: Supported Sit-to-Stand
cues: Sit tall at the front of the chair
Push through your feet, hands on your thighs
Stand tall, then sit back slowly
inSetCues: Nose over your toes, then stand
Sit back slowly, do not drop

movements.name: High Wall Sit
cues: Back on the wall, slide down a little
Feet flat, knees soft
Hold and breathe steadily
inSetCues: Knees over your ankles, not past your toes
Back on the wall, keep breathing

movements.name: Partial Squat
cues: Feet hip-width, arms forward for balance
Bend your knees a little, hips back
Stand tall through your whole foot
inSetCues: If your heels lift, sit back more
Knees in line with your toes

movements.name: Sit-to-Stand
cues: Sit tall, feet flat on the floor
Stand up without using your hands
Sit back slowly and quietly
inSetCues: Land soft, do not drop onto the seat
If your knees fall inward, press them apart

movements.name: Wall Sit
cues: Back flat on the wall
Slide down, knees over your ankles
Hold and breathe
inSetCues: If you drift upward, slide back down
Hands off your thighs, keep breathing

movements.name: Half Squat
cues: Feet hip-width apart
Sit halfway down, hips back
Drive up through your whole foot
inSetCues: Chest tall, do not fold forward
Press your knees out over your toes

movements.name: Air Squat
cues: Feet a little wider than your hips
Chest up, knees track over your toes
Sit down low, then push the floor away
inSetCues: If your heels lift, squat less deep
Knees out, over your little toes

movements.name: Sumo Squat
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out
Sit straight down, chest tall
Press up through your heels
inSetCues: Knees follow your toes, out not in
If you fold forward, sit less deep

movements.name: Paused Squat
cues: Sit to the bottom of your squat
Pause there for two slow breaths
Stand up strong
inSetCues: If your back rounds, pause higher
Breathe through the pause, chest tall

movements.name: Split Squat
cues: One foot forward, one foot back
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Push up through your front foot
Keep your chest tall
inSetCues: Front knee tracks over your toes
Drive through your front heel, chest tall

movements.name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back, lower your back knee
Front knee over your ankle
Push through your front foot to stand
inSetCues: Front knee stays over your front ankle
Push through your front heel to stand

movements.name: Elevated Split Squat
cues: Chair against a wall, back foot on the seat
Lower straight down, chest tall
Drive up through your front foot
inSetCues: If your front knee caves, press out
Front foot flat, keep your hips square

movements.name: Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand
cues: Sit tall, one foot off the floor
Stand up on one leg, slow and steady
Lower back down with control
A fingertip on the chair is fine
inSetCues: Standing knee stays over your toes
Lower slowly on your standing leg

movements.name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent
Press through your heels, lift your hips
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly
inSetCues: If your back arches, lift less high
Ribs down, squeeze your glutes, keep breathing

movements.name: Glute Bridge Hold
cues: Lift your hips and hold them high
Keep squeezing the whole time
Ribs down, breathe steadily
inSetCues: If your hips sink, squeeze back up
Heels heavy, ribs down, keep breathing

movements.name: Standing Hip Hinge
cues: Feet hip-width, soft knees
Push your hips back, chest forward
Keep your back long
Stand tall and squeeze
inSetCues: If your back rounds, hinge less far
Push your hips back, knees stay soft

movements.name: Glute Bridge March
cues: Hold your bridge high
Lift one foot, then the other
Keep your hips level and steady
inSetCues: Press through your planted heel, hips level
Ribs down, keep breathing as you march

movements.name: Paused Glute Bridge
cues: Lift your hips high
Pause and squeeze at the top
Lower slowly, quiet and controlled
inSetCues: Breathe out at the top, ribs down
Squeeze your glutes, not your lower back

movements.name: Hinge and Reach
cues: Push your hips back, reach your arms forward
Back stays long, knees soft
Stand tall, arms back down
inSetCues: If your back rounds, reach less far
Hips back first, then reach

movements.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: One knee bent, the other leg long
Press through one heel, lift your hips
Keep your hips level
Lower with control
inSetCues: If your hips tilt, lift less high
Press through your working heel, ribs down

movements.name: Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
cues: Chair against a wall, heels on the seat
Lift your hips high
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly
inSetCues: Heels heavy on the seat, ribs down
If your ribs flare, lift less high

movements.name: Single-Leg Hip Hinge
cues: Stand on one leg, soft knee
Hinge forward, back leg reaches behind you
Back long, hips square
Stand tall to finish
inSetCues: If you wobble, hinge less far
Standing knee soft, keep your hips square

movements.name: Hip Thrust
cues: Chair against a wall, shoulders on the seat
Feet flat, drive your hips to the ceiling
Chin tucked, ribs down
Lower slowly
inSetCues: Ribs down, chin tucked at the top
Breathe out as your hips drive up

movements.name: Single-Leg Elevated Bridge
cues: Chair against a wall, one heel on the seat
Other leg toward the ceiling
Press through your heel, lift your hips
Keep your hips square
inSetCues: If your hips twist, lift less high
Working heel heavy, keep your hips square

movements.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
cues: Shoulders on the seat, one foot planted
Drive your hips up through one heel
Hips level, lower slowly
inSetCues: Hips level, ribs down at the top
Drive through your planted heel, keep breathing

movements.name: Wall Plank
cues: Hands on the wall, walk your feet back
One straight line from head to heels
Press the wall away and hold
Breathe steadily
inSetCues: Press the wall away, hips in line
Keep breathing, shoulders away from your ears

movements.name: Seated Knee Lift
cues: Sit tall, hands by your hips
Grow tall as you lift one knee
Lower quietly, switch sides
inSetCues: If you lean back, lift less high
Sit tall, breathe out as you lift

movements.name: Lying Heel Slide
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent
Slide one heel away until the leg is long
Keep your lower back settled
Slide it back, switch sides
inSetCues: If your back arches, slide less far
Breathe out as your heel slides away

movements.name: Incline Plank
cues: Chair against a wall, hands on the seat
Straight line from head to heels
Hold steady and breathe
inSetCues: If your hips drop, squeeze your glutes
Push the seat away, keep breathing

movements.name: Kneeling Balance Reach
cues: On hands and knees, back flat
Reach one arm and the opposite leg long
Hips stay level
Return slowly, switch sides
inSetCues: If your hips tip, reach lower
Back flat, breathe out as you reach

movements.name: Lying Heel Tap
cues: On your back, knees above your hips
Lower one heel to tap the floor
Keep your lower back settled
Switch sides
inSetCues: If your back arches, lower less far
Breathe out as your heel taps down

movements.name: Knee Plank
cues: Forearms down, knees down
One line from knees to head
Press the floor away and breathe
inSetCues: Hips down in line, squeeze your glutes
Press the floor away, keep breathing

movements.name: Knee Side Plank
cues: On your side, forearm down, knees bent
Lift your hips into one line
Hold and breathe
inSetCues: Bottom elbow under your shoulder, hips up
Hips up and forward, keep breathing

movements.name: Full Plank
cues: Forearms down, legs long
One straight line from head to heels
Squeeze your middle, breathe steadily
inSetCues: If your hips sag, drop your knees
Push the floor away, breathe steadily

movements.name: Side Plank
cues: Forearm down, legs long and stacked
Lift your hips into one line
Hold steady and breathe
inSetCues: If your hips drop, bottom knee down
Press through your bottom forearm, hips high

movements.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
cues: Hands under shoulders, feet a little wide
Tap one shoulder, hips stay still
Slow and quiet, switch sides
inSetCues: If your hips sway, widen your feet
Tap slowly, hips still and square

movements.name: Plank Walkout
cues: Stand tall, hinge down, hands to the floor
Walk your hands out to a plank
Pause, then walk back and stand
Keep your hips steady
inSetCues: If your hips sag, walk less far
Small steps, hips steady, keep breathing
